purpose: Recruitment/priming/expansion component of immunotherapy resistance review; inference from already available data.
main_conclusion: Poor local recruitment is supported across both independently re-quantified archival tumour samples, but absence of useful tumour-specific cells is not established. Personalised vaccines and N-803 target different steps: antigen-specific priming versus expansion/activation. They might indirectly start an IFNg–CXCL9/10 feedback loop, but do not reliably repair trafficking, stromal entry or antigen-presentation defects.

five_step_model.name: Priming: teach immune cells which tumour targets to recognise
case_support_for_bottleneck: MSS/low tissue TMB and no demonstrated vaccine-specific or tumour-reactive TCR response leave ineffective priming plausible.
Tempus XCR1 0.06 TPM and CLEC9A 0, with low-count evidence, are compatible with few cross-presenting cDC1 cells; BostonGene IRF8 is5th CRC percentile.
case_counterevidence: BostonGene BATF3 55th, CD1C 97th, ITGAX 77th, CIITA 66th; CD1C reflects a different dendritic lineage and ITGAX is not cDC1-specific.
B7 ITGAX 15, CD74 3 and HLA-DRA 7 vendor-unique sequences support some antigen-presenting/myeloid machinery. CD74/HLA II also occur in B cells and other cells.
Caris XCR1 1.13 TPM and nonzero CLEC9A 0.43TPM; research IRF8 is not uniformly low. No blanket dendritic-cell absence can be inferred.
five_step_model.vaccine_role: Best direct mechanistic match: provide defined antigens with an appropriate delivery/adjuvant platform to generate or broaden CD4/CD8 responses, potentially through lymph-node antigen-presenting cells outside the tumour.
five_step_model.N803_role: Can support activated/memory CD8 and NK cells; it is not an antigen-specific priming substitute. NK-derived chemokines may support dendritic-cell circuits but this is not demonstrated in this patient.
five_step_model.confidence: Plausible but unproven functional shortage; moderate evidence of capacity, no proof of successful tumour-specific priming.

five_step_model.name: Expansion and survival: build and maintain useful T and NK cells
case_support_for_bottleneck: BostonGene TCF7 is 1st CRC percentile; IL15RA 2nd, IL2RB 10th, IL2RG 6th. These bulk values can reflect cell mixture, not receptor failure.
BostonGene deconvolution reports sparse activated immune populations; reported recent lymphopenia does not identify which clones are missing.
case_counterevidence: IL15 itself is 94th BostonGene CRC percentile, so the evidence does not show an IL-15 ligand deficiency.
Caris/Tempus IL15 6.55/6.45TPM, IL15RA 17.94/13.59, IL2RB 4.49/6.36, IL2RG 68.88/28.49; coding-only estimates differ materially for some receptors.
IL7R 65.91/62.48TPM; BostonGene 61st. CD4 protein 3 unique sequences and PTPRC 18 support immune-cell presence, not function.
five_step_model.vaccine_role: Can increase selected antigen-specific clones and memory; bulk expression does not establish whether the correct clones exist.
five_step_model.N803_role: Closest intended function: stimulate IL-2/15 beta-gamma receptors to expand/activate NK and CD8 cells. Its built-in IL-15Ralpha component means low endogenous IL15RA is neither a proven requirement nor a validated response biomarker.
five_step_model.confidence: Reasonable adjunct rationale, no demonstrated causal IL15 defect or personal-response biomarker.

five_step_model.name: Recruitment: attract useful immune cells to the lesion
case_support_for_bottleneck: CXCL9/10/11 are all below the lower quartile of the18primaryCRC research references in both Caris andTempus; low counts limit precision.
Caris TPM0.475/1.066/0; Tempus 1.806/1.678/0.908. Reference medians 5.717/14.811/5.395. BostonGene CXCL9 28th, CXCL10 3rd, CXCR3 4th; IFNG not assigned fragments in either research sample.
CCL5Caris 5.03/Tempus 10.83 TPM andBostonGene 25th give additional, less uniform support for reduced effector recruitment.
case_counterevidence: Research CXCR3 3.30/1.87TPM is not consistently below the reference; low ligand and low receptor claims must be separated.
BostonGene CD8A 56th and KLRD1 61st are not uniformly low; some immune cells/effector transcripts remain.

Whole Hallmark IFNg response is method-sensitive: coding-meanlog ranks with Caris 0/18 and Tempus 7/18 reference samples lower; total-transcript meanlog7/18 and 15/18. Three low chemokines do not prove complete IFNg pathway shutdown.
five_step_model.vaccine_role: Indirect conditional effect: newly primed tumour-reactive cells could seed a lesion and release IFNg, inducing local CXCL9/10/11 and a positive recruitment loop if local myeloid/stromal/epithelial IFN responses remain inducible.
five_step_model.N803_role: Human systemic studies demonstrate IFNg/NK/CD8 activation. The same feedback could amplify recruitment, but more circulating cells alone does not establish a chemokine gradient or successful entry.
five_step_model.confidence: Stronger archival support for weak local recruitment cues than for absent immune capacity; no current-node diagnosis.

five_step_model.name: Entry: cross tumour vessels and stroma
case_support_for_bottleneck: Treated resection has high CXCL12 (Tempus 96.50 TPM, BostonGene 99th) and selective CAF/matrix proteins; THBS2/ITGA5 enrichment provides an additional recruitment/adhesion hypothesis.
case_counterevidence: Earlier Caris CXCL12 7.63 TPM, clinical FN1 4th and VEGFA 6th percentiles; no uniformly stromal-high biopsy.
Smooth-muscle/repair admixture and noninflamed tumour can resemble exclusion in bulk; no demonstrated CD8 pile-up at a stromal boundary.
B4 RNA/B7 protein are archival 2024 tissues and not the recent resistant node.
five_step_model.vaccine_role: Does not directly remove matrix, normalize vessels or neutralize CXCL12/TGF-associated restraints. Human vaccine-specific TCR tumour tracking shows entry can sometimes occur, not that it is guaranteed.
five_step_model.N803_role: Does not directly dismantle those barriers. Activated NK/CD8 cells can still be retained outside tumour nests or suppressed after entry.
five_step_model.confidence: Strong archival stromal context; physical exclusion and current relevance remain unproven.

five_step_model.name: Recognition and killing: identify the cancer cell and eliminate it
case_support_for_bottleneck: BostonGene IRF1/TAP1/HLA-A/B/C 2nd/1st/2nd/5th/3rd percentiles support a local presentation/IFN-restraint hypothesis.
NKG7 3.18/2.21 TPM, PRF1 6.93/1.14, low IFNG and sparse activation estimates suggest limited useful cytotoxic activity could coexist.
case_counterevidence: Caris provider-matched IRF1/TAP1/HLA-A/B/C 53.6/46.3/55.0/54.2/29.2 percentiles oppose a universal presentation-loss claim.
B7 STAT1/TAP1/TAP2/B2M/HLA-A/B/C are supported by 26/8/11/3/5/5/4 vendor-unique sequences; total proteins do not establish malignant-cell surface localization.

CD8A 0.75/2.74 TPM, BostonGene 56th; GZMB and PRF1 are detected by RNA. NK/T cells were recovered in the separate liver sample. Neither their presence nor bulk markers establish tumour specificity or actual killing.
five_step_model.vaccine_role: Targets must remain expressed and be processed/displayed by the relevant HLA allele. Vaccination cannot by itself correct fixed antigen/HLA loss; existing candidate sequences and host response are separate evidence levels.
five_step_model.N803_role: Could amplify CD8 killing and NK killing/antibody-dependent cytotoxicity. NK function can partly bypass classical HLA-I recognition but depends on activating/inhibitory balance, trafficking and survival; this is not a proven rescue of this tumour.
five_step_model.confidence: Presentation machinery is present but function and cell location unresolved; neither complete loss nor competence is established.

therapy_priority_within_this_axis.approach: Personalised vaccine as a priming component of a clinician-led investigational strategy
therapy_priority_within_this_axis.rationale: Direct antigen-specific priming role and patient-specific expressed-mutation candidates; humanMSSCRC immunogenicity and occasional responses.
therapy_priority_within_this_axis.limits: Current target display and patient-specific immune response unconfirmed; benefit after BOT/BAL and optimal platform/partners unproven. No assumption of administered treatment.

therapy_priority_within_this_axis.approach: SystemicN-803 as an optional expansion/activation partner
therapy_priority_within_this_axis.rationale: Human NK/CD8 pharmacodynamic activity; plausible support for vaccine-generated clones and NK effectors.
therapy_priority_within_this_axis.limits: No established MSS CRC benefit, no validated biomarker from IL15/IL15R bulk RNA, weak direct CRC results and randomized NSCLC counterevidence. Not a direct recruitment repair and not equivalent to licensed intravesical ANKTIVA.

combination_reasoning: A rational combination would need retained antigen recognition plus useful clones plus permissive recruitment/entry. Pairing vaccine and N-803 covers only part of this sequence. Adding checkpoint, TGF, adenosine or other partners is a hypothesis; cross-study response rates cannot be added or converted to a personal probability. No clinical data establish the exact personalised vaccine+N-803+vactosertib+BOT/BAL combination.
capacity_vs_shortage_summary: Available RNA/proteins support the existence of antigen-presenting, CD4/T-cell and interferon/presentation machinery. They give weaker and discordant evidence for the quantity of specialised cDC1, NK or useful antigen-specific CD8 cells. Some genes are low because of cell composition, low counts or transcript allocation. The clearest shared feature is weak CXCR3-ligand expression, not total immune-system absence.

source_boundaries.contribution: Independent research RNA plus 84 original clinical percentiles and 5 Nov7 provider values. Early FN1/VEGFA low; antigen-presentation five near median. No assay-matched CXCL9/10/11percentiles located.
Independent research RNA; low chemokines, high CXCL12, mixed APC/lymphocyte markers. Coding sensitivity prevents over-reading totalTPM.
Vendor log2(TPM+1) and CRC percentiles plus deconvolution. Same block as Tempus, not an independent lesion. CXCL10/CXCR3/IRF8/TCF7low, CD1C/ITGAX and IL15 not low.
One different block of same archival operation. Presentation/APC proteins present; many cytokines and lineage markers unreported. No activation, specific TCR recognition or current node assessment.

16 cell types/92,897 recovered cells; CD8 T 2,231, CD4 T 1,187, NK 1,732, dividing T/NK 54. These counts are recovery-biased. Only 5 of 156 queried genes appear in 101-gene export(CD274,CD44,FAP,LRRC15,NT5E); recruitment/DC/IL15 genes are not tested by this export.
Full 156-gene query retained, but specimen provenance unresolved; no independent-liver/current-lesion inference.
Immune transcripts present in blood; cfRNA/buffy CD3D 15.05/23.56, CD8A 5.74/8.38, NKG7 21.84/7.25 TPM. These cannot establish tumour infiltration, antigen-specificity or systemic cell counts.
No native RNA/proteomics data located; archival RNA/protein cannot establish mechanism of current post-BOT/BAL resistance.

feasible_available_data_next_steps: Resolve delivered vaccine status and final antigen sequences from existing records; do not equate manufacturing with administration.
Use existing mutation/RNA evidence and HLA typing to prioritise retained expressed targets, keeping prediction distinct from display.
Re-review existing digital pathology/spatial images, if adequate and already available, for immune-desert versus boundary retention; bulk deconvolution cannot supply geometry.
Request existing provider assay-matched chemokine/immune percentiles or underlying cell matrix/metadata where obtainable; this is a data request, not a new tissue experiment.
If serial blood or vaccine monitoring results already exist, reconcile those with treatment dates before interpreting treatment-induced immunity.
tissue_constraint: Insufficient cryopreserved tissue: no culture/organoid, tissue-slice, ex vivo killing, or other wet-lab experiments proposed. No tissue allocation assumed.
clinical_caution: This is a mechanism/strength-of-evidence ranking, not a prescription or individual response estimate. Comparative outcomes from different cancers and regimens are not additive.

plans.title: JLF personalized peptide vaccine
plans.body: My personalized peptide vaccine is designed; I understand manufacturing is underway. The JLF list records proposed precursors, HLA restrictions and epitopes. Final manufactured peptides and administration remain undocumented here.

plans.title: Personalised mRNA vaccine research
plans.status_label: Research design available; update under consideration
plans.body: The vaccine target report lists candidate rankings, peptide sequences and DNA/RNA evidence. I plan an mRNA vaccine and am considering updating targets from my recent nodal biopsy. A final construct, manufacturing release and administration remain undocumented.

candidate_examples.summary: Fifty-four high-quality fragments phase the somatic change with a downstream germline variant; no fragments supported the alternative proposed haplotype.
Primary RNA audit counted 708 alternate among 1,681 informative fragments; the report display of zero is contradicted by the embedded reads.

case_vaccine_evidence.interpretation: These are research designs with archival expressed-mutant evidence. They do not prove final manufacture, administration, current tumour display, vaccine-specific T cells or response. No withdrawn renderer/provider calibration material was used.

publication_note: Historic provider branding and internal workspace paths removed; factual findings, dates and status are unchanged. These historical plans do not establish current manufacture or administration.
